scenes.alt: यज्ञ की आग के पास तीन बेटों को भेजता पिता
scenes.prompt: A village courtyard with a lit sacrificial fire, neighbours carrying wood, ghee and water; the householder sends his three sons toward the road.

scenes.alt: समंदर किनारे धीरे सरकता कछुआ और ठिठके खड़े तीन भाई
scenes.prompt: A grey restless sea; a large moss-backed turtle crawls on wet sand leaving a smooth trail; the three brothers stand around it, none touching it.

scenes.alt: झगड़ते तीन भाई, पीछे पानी की ओर जाता कछुआ
scenes.prompt: The brothers argue with raised voices and pointing hands on the beach; behind their backs the turtle slides toward the water.

scenes.alt: दरबार में अपना अजीब झगड़ा सुनाते तीन भाई
scenes.prompt: A full court; the three brothers present their dispute; the king rests his chin on his hand, studying them like odd gemstones; courtiers hide smiles.

scenes.alt: सोने की थाली में भात, जिसे दो उँगलियों से दूर सरकाता बड़ा भाई
scenes.prompt: A feast: a golden plate with a mound of fine white rice; the eldest brother pushes it away with two fingers, pale; a proud cook gapes.

scenes.alt: दरबार में धान की बालियाँ लिए खड़ा बूढ़ा किसान, मुँह फेरता बड़ा भाई
scenes.prompt: An old farmer with cracked hands and bent shoulders holds ears of paddy with dignity in the glittering court; the eldest brother turns his face away, cloth to nose; silence.

scenes.alt: दीयों और मालाओं वाले कमरे में पीछे हटता मँझला भाई और हँसती गणिका
scenes.prompt: A room with lamps and flower garlands; a celebrated courtesan, an elegant adult woman in silk, laughs openly with her head back, holding a water cup; the middle brother cowers at the far side, hand on nose. Dignified, not sensual.

scenes.alt: दरबार में सिर ऊँचा कर अपने बचपन की बकरी की बात बताती गणिका
scenes.prompt: In the morning court the courtesan stands self-possessed, telling her story; a small painted inset shows an infant beside a gentle she-goat; the middle brother's ears red.

scenes.alt: सात गद्दों वाले ऊँचे पलंग पर पसली पकड़कर रोता छोटा भाई
scenes.prompt: A towering bed of seven plump mattresses with a footstool; the youngest brother sits up weeping, hand at his ribs; guards rush in with a lamp.

scenes.alt: दीये के पास दो उँगलियों में एक बाल उठाए राजा
scenes.prompt: King Prasenajit holds one thin curved hair up to a lamp; seven mattresses piled on the floor; a faint red line on the youngest brother's side.

scenes.alt: बुझती साँझ में यज्ञ की आग के पास रास्ता ताकता पिता
scenes.prompt: An old father at his courtyard door at dusk looks down the empty sea road; behind him the sacrificial fire he keeps alive.
